summary: Added train and validation equity curve plots in Phase 5 (phase5_oos.py) using the same non-fatal try/except pattern as the existing test plot. Added 7 unit tests verifying all three splits are plotted, empty trade logs (DataFrame() or None) do not crash, and exactly 3 calls per direction.

changes.phase5_oos.py: Added reporter.plot_equity_curve calls for 'train' and 'validation' splits after the existing 'test' call, each wrapped in try/except with a warning log. Uses trade_logs_by_split.get() for safe access.
changes.test_phase5_oos.py: Added TestEquityCurvePlots class with 7 tests: test_plot_equity_called_for_train_validation_test, test_plot_equity_called_exactly_three_times, test_empty_train_log_does_not_crash, test_empty_validation_log_does_not_crash, test_empty_test_log_does_not_crash, test_all_empty_logs_does_not_crash, test_none_logs_do_not_crash.

risks: If plot_equity_curve itself crashes on an empty DataFrame, the non-fatal try/except will catch it and log a warning. From the reporter source, the method accesses columns and rows, so an empty DataFrame should raise and be caught safely.
